long_biography.plain_text:
SafeCard began with a simple consumer problem: how to notify multiple issuers quickly when a wallet was lost or stolen. In 1969, Peter Halmos and his younger brother Steven launched the company from a Fort Lauderdale apartment, turning card registration and issuer notification into a recurring subscription service.

The business later operated at national scale, while Halmos moved from chief executive and chairman into family-foundation work. He remains president of the Peter Halmos Family Foundation in 2026. Foundation work is now his principal documented public role. Its grantmaking supports education, health care and community organisations in Florida and California.
